title: End-to-end DDA reanalysis of the pilot dataset (containerized)
context: With the pipeline skeleton, provenance linter, and gate-approved pilot dataset in place, the first real end-to-end DDA reanalysis can run. This task implements the full analysis pipeline (spectrum processing → search → FDR → quantification → stats) for the pilot dataset, using pinned containers referenced by immutable digest, and produces a complete run manifest. Every published quantitative assertion must carry provenance and pass the CI provenance gate. Only small aggregate result tables are published; raw data stays at the source accession.
objective: Implement and run the end-to-end DDA reanalysis pipeline for the gate-approved pilot dataset, producing a complete run manifest, FDR-controlled results, provenance-passing CI, and only aggregate result tables — with raw data never re-hosted.
acceptanceCriteria: The pipeline runs end-to-end in pinned containers (immutable digests) under the workflow manager: spectrum processing → search/identification → FDR control → quantification → statistical analysis.

A complete run manifest is produced recording: dataset accession + input file checksums, container digests, tool versions (MaxQuant/FragPipe/MSFragger/OpenMS + version), all parameters, reference-DB versions/checksums (UniProt release), random seeds, operator, environment, and duration.
100% of published quantitative assertions carry a resolvable run-manifest entry and pass the CI provenance gate from provenance-005.
Only small aggregate result tables are published (protein-level summaries, FDR summary); raw mass-spec files are referenced by PRIDE accession only and never re-hosted.
Pipeline code is MIT-licensed; aggregate result tables are CC-BY-4.0; commit is DCO signed-off.
pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint pass; methods review and license/re-id review are passed before merge.
resources: PLAN.md — Pipeline stages, Tech stack section
output: A committed PR containing the end-to-end DDA reanalysis pipeline for the pilot dataset, the run manifest, passing CI provenance gate, and aggregate result tables; code MIT, tables CC-BY-4.0.
